conflict.title: This record was changed by someone else
conflict.body: The record was updated while you were editing. Load the latest version and apply your changes again.

validation.factorPositive: The factor must be greater than zero.
validation.factorRange: The factor can have at most 14 integer and 6 decimal digits.
validation.duplicateKey: This attribute name is already used.
validation.dateOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.percentRange: The discount must be greater than 0 and at most 100.
validation.scopeRef: Select a record for the scope.
validation.code: Codes may only contain letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.

savedFilters.title: Saved views
savedFilters.saveBody: The search and filters are stored under this name and can be applied with one click.
savedFilters.name: View name

units.title: Units
units.description: Manage units of measure and the conversion factors between them.

conversions.title: Unit conversion table
conversions.help: Enter how many column units one row unit equals. One direction is enough; the reverse is shown faded.
conversions.needUnits: At least two active units are needed to define conversions.
conversions.partialFailure_one: {{count}} cell could not be saved; see the message below it.
conversions.partialFailure_other: {{count}} cells could not be saved; see the messages below them.

categories.title: Item categories
categories.description: Organise categories as a tree. Drag to move, or use “Move”.
categories.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys; → expands, ← collapses. Enter edits, Insert adds a subcategory, M moves, Delete deletes.
categories.dropRoot: Drop here to move to the top level
categories.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. A category with subcategories or items cannot be deleted.
categories.moveBody: Choose the new parent. Leave it empty to move the category to the top level.
categories.parentHelp: Leave empty to place the category at the top level.
categories.cycleHint: Itself or a subcategory; cannot be selected

cycle.descendant: {{parent}} is a subcategory of {{name}}. This move would create a cycle.

items.title: Items
items.description: Stock and service items. Search covers code, name, SKU and barcode.
items.saveFirst: Save the item first to add variants, barcodes and alternate units.
items.baseUnitLocked: The base unit cannot be changed once the item has movements.
items.taxHelp: Documents use this tax code by default.
items.activeHelp: Deactivate used items instead of deleting them.
items.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Items with movements cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.

variants.help: Sub-items that differ by attributes such as colour or size. SKUs are unique across the company.

barcode.help: The check digit of EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A barcodes is verified before saving.
barcode.empty: No barcodes defined for this item.
barcode.primaryHelp: Labels and documents use this barcode.

problem.digits: This barcode type contains digits only.
problem.length: The length does not match this barcode type.

itemUnits.help: Define units such as boxes or packs with a factor to the base unit ({{base}}).
itemUnits.removeBody: {{unit}} will be removed from this item.
itemUnits.previewEmpty: Enter a valid factor to see the preview.

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.description: Sales price lists; a party's own list takes precedence over the default list.
priceLists.isDefaultHelp: Used when the party has no list of its own. Only one list can be the default.
priceLists.saveFirst: Save the list first to add lines.
priceLists.deleteBody: {{name}} and all of its lines will be deleted.

priceLines.title: Price lines
priceLines.hint: Enter moves to the next cell and opens a new line from the last one; Ctrl+S saves all lines.
priceLines.tooMany: This list has more than {{max}} lines and cannot be edited in the browser. Update the lines by import.
priceLines.incomplete: The list changed while loading; saving an incomplete list is not allowed. Load again.
priceLines.changedElsewhere: The lines changed elsewhere while you were editing. Load the server lines to save; your edits will be lost.

discounts.title: Discount rules
discounts.description: Percentage discounts for items, categories or parties. The highest priority wins.
discounts.allHelp: The rule applies to all items.
discounts.partyHelp: When set, the rule only applies to this party.
discounts.minQtyHelp: Leave empty to apply at any quantity.
discounts.priorityHelp: When several rules match, the one with the highest priority applies.
discounts.stackableHelp: When checked, applies together with other stackable rules.

pricing.title: Price calculator
pricing.description: See which price and discount the system picks for an item, party, quantity and date.
pricing.partyHelp: Leave empty to use the default list.
pricing.failed: The price could not be calculated
pricing.empty: Fill in the inputs and press “Calculate price”.
pricing.noPrice: No valid price was found for these conditions.
pricing.precedenceHelp: The resolver applies the steps in this order; the first match wins.

partyList.title: Party price list
partyList.body: If the party has its own list and the item is on it, that list is used first.

defaultList.title: Default price list
defaultList.body: Without a party price, the company's default list is used.

validity.title: Validity date
validity.body: The validity period of the list and the line must include the chosen date.

minQty.title: Best quantity tier
minQty.body: Among lines whose minimum quantity does not exceed the requested quantity, the highest tier is chosen.

discount.title: Discount rule
discount.body: Of the matching rules, the one with the highest priority applies.

stacking.title: Stacking
stacking.body: Discounts are not added up; only rules marked “stackable” apply together.
